_meta.what: Real driving time on the model's roads: base minutes (posted or class speed) times a factor by road type, plus seconds per traffic light and per stop sign. Fitted to TomTom typical weekday daytime trip times (8 am, noon, 5 pm, 8 pm), 40 trips; written by python3 -m nfprep.road_times fit. route_preference: how much more than its minutes a driver weighs each road type when choosing a route, fitted to the traffic counts (python3 -m nfprep.road_times search).
_meta.route_choice: Drivers follow navigation (the owner's first-hand observation: residents and visitors use it and take its route), so routes are the fastest at real minutes, with no preference by road type. Tried against the counts: none 0.649, arterials weighed at x0.78 0.658 (docs/route_preference_search.json); the count gap comes from elsewhere.
